title: London - Enterprise AI Summit: travel & expense checklist
content:
Quick working notes for Enterprise AI Summit (London) — scratchpad for logistics, receipts, vendors, and reimbursement. Informal, keep synced with Confluence but this is my fast checklist.

Trip summary:
- Dates: 2026-04-12 (depart) -> 2026-04-16 (return). Conference 13-15 Apr.
- Location: Business Design Centre / London (Islington). Hotel: Camden Grove Hotel (booked via travel portal).

Pre-trip TODOs:
- Make sure passport expiry > 6 months (check). ACTION: scan passport front/back and upload to travel folder (by 2026-03-15).
- Confirm Heathrow pickup (Ben to confirm driver or reimburse taxi).
- Expense advance? No advance approved; will submit receipts within 7 days post-trip.
- Verify conference badge pickup time (expo email says badge collection opens at 07:30 daily).
- Add emergency contact: Li (Liang) +44 7700 900111.

Travel & booking details (copy of confirmations in travel folder):
- Flight (roundtrip): BA198, depart SFO 12 Apr 17:20 -> LHR 13 Apr 11:50 local. Return BA201 on 16 Apr 13:15 -> SFO 16 Apr 16:05 PDT (overnight inbound due to time zones).
- Hotel: Camden Grove Hotel, confirmation #CGH-98123. Check-in 13 Apr after 14:00, check-out 16 Apr 11:00.
- Conference registration: Enterprise AI Summit - Exhibitor pass (booth C18).

Daily rough schedule (personal):
- 13 Apr: badge, booth setup 08:00-12:00, keynote 13:30, evening partner dinner 19:00 (invite from Redwood ops).
- 14 Apr: sessions 09:00-17:00, demo slots at booth 11:15 and 15:30.
- 15 Apr: morning talks, wrap, pack, debrief w/ Ben 16:00.

Expense rules / reminders (finance policy + practical):
- Capture every receipt (meals, taxi, Ubers, hotel incidentals). Use Expensify app and tag TRVL-LON-2026.
- Per-diem guidance: use itemized receipts for meals. If no receipt, log meal at max \u00a360/day (company guideline for London), but try to avoid missing receipts.
- Taxis: prefer receipts with company name or booking id. If reimbursing card, include last 4 digits of card used.
- Public transit: Oyster/contactless topped with single fares - keep screenshot of daily top-ups if used (finance accepts transit screenshots).
- Conference catering: if lunch provided, don't charge lunch as expense. Mark in note.
- VAT: ask vendor for VAT invoice where possible (hotel VAT is reclaimable in some cases; Finance can advise).
- Approver: Ben Carter (manager) — include short note on purpose of trip and booth costs.
- GL codes (finance): Travel = 6001, Meals = 6205, Lodging = 6002, Events/Booth = 7004. Put GL on expense form or in expense note.

Vendor / contact list (keep handy):
- Hotel: Camden Grove Hotel - Reservations: +44 20 7946 0123 / reservations@camdengrove.co.uk (contact: Rachel Mills).
- Shuttle / Airport transfer: HeathrowExpress not pre-booked. Local transfer vendor: Thames Transfers +44 20 3868 1234, ref Redwood-Business (Ben coordinating).
- Conference organizer: Enterprise AI Summit - operations@enterpriseai-summit.com / +44 20 7007 5588 (contact: Priya Nair). AV contact for booth: AV Solutions — av@enterpriseai-summit.com / +44 20 7007 5599.
- Catering vendor (booth snacks): London Snacks Co. contact: Mark H. mark@londonsnacks.co / +44 7812 345678 (invoice to Redwood).
- Print / signage vendor near venue: FastPrint Ltd — fastprintlondon.com / orders@fastprintlondon.com (Ben to confirm pickup window).

Booth & materials checklist (for setup):
- Banner x2 (arrive in booth: yes).
- Demo laptop + HDMI adaptors (Mac -> HDMI, USB-C).
- Power strip + labeled chargers.
- Business cards (handful left) + sticker giveaway (100).
- Extension cable (Ben bringing).
- Printed one-pager: "Redwood Inference — production inference, hosted/dedicated/private" (get 100 copies).

Receipts capture process (my note):
1) Photograph paper receipts immediately, upload to Expensify under TRVL-LON-2026.
2) For card receipts, forward emailed invoices to expenses@redwood.ai with Trip ID.
3) Tag items in Expensify with GL code and short purpose (e.g., "booth setup - cable purchase").
4) Submit expense report within 7 days of return (deadline 2026-04-23).

Unresolved questions / items to follow up:
- Booth electricity charge? Confirm if venue charges separately (Priya to confirm).
- Are demo internet lines included or is a dedicated connection an extra fee? Need AV contact confirmation.
- Per-diem policy for client dinners (is meal > \u00a360 allowed with receipt?). Ask Finance (CC: Sarah Park).
- Can we get pre-printed badges for staff (fast lane)? If so need list of names by 2026-03-31.

Post-trip debrief notes (what I want to capture after):
- Lead quality notes (template) + top 10 demos asked.
- Token-latency anecdote for sales/solutions (any live demo flakiness).
- Booth spend vs. expected ROI.
- Recommend next steps: follow-up cadence and who owns follow-ups.

Quick packing checklist (personal):
- Passport + printed boarding pass (or stored on phone).
- UK power adapter + spare USB-C cable.
- Demo laptop + dongles + charger + clean install of demo code.
- Business cards + one-pager + stickers.
- Light blazer, 2 button shirts, comfy shoes.
- Expensify app: logged in + company card set as default.

Notes to self (short):
- Keep receipts separate envelope in laptop bag (paper) and photograph immediately.
- Ask Ben to pre-approve any urgent booth purchases up to \u00a3500 to avoid delays.
- Post a short Slack thread in #events with outbound booth times so ops team knows when to assist.

End of scratchpad. Update before departure with any changes.

-- Sam
